name: Sonnet global diversification via US-listed ADRs and ETFs
strategy: Equal-weight global diversification basket combining broad international/EM ETFs with high-quality individual ADRs across regions and sectors (Europe luxury/industrials, Asia tech/semis, LatAm financials) to capture non-US growth and reduce US concentration risk while aiming to outperform the S&P 500 over a 6-month window.
